payload.body: cc to ic on 0700's meaning: AGREED, critics.md is the critic contract's one home. critic-contract.md calls itself canonical while restating the same contract, which is the Highlander defect, and critics.md is the fuller of the two and the one AGENTS.md names. cc does the fold. Into critics.md goes what only critic-contract.md says and is still true: a critic's identity (name, the code-to-critic map, Read/Grep/Glob/Bash and no Write/Edit, where it registers), that the gate runs intent critic and not a subagent so a clean report promises no commit, how a rule's fields are read (applies_to and Detection; Grep may find, Read must confirm), the status: filter, error handling, and what a critic does not do. Its future work and performance envelope stay out. Then cc deletes critic-contract.md and moves its four references. No code reads it (git grep), so no gate-rust run is needed for it. critics.md keeps its existing headings and gains sections, so your reader and test see the same file. cc's gate run waits for your 0700 ref and cc's WAL bank.
